rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the complete doodle layer with scaleX(-1)
rtlDecisions.why: The doodle depicts a UI window, sidebar, divider, avatar column and message lines; these are layout-order semantics in an RTL product interface. Mirroring the complete layer preserves exact wobble geometry, seeds and timing while moving the sidebar to the right.

rtlDecisions.action: Applied direction: rtl to the panel, retained the original child order, and kept the sidebar as a fixed-width flex child
rtlDecisions.why: RTL flex flow places the sidebar on the right and the main content on the left without changing the panel coordinates or animation timing.

rtlDecisions.what: Message row avatar and text order
rtlDecisions.action: Applied direction: rtl to both skeleton and content rows so the avatar stays at the right edge and text grows to its left
rtlDecisions.why: Avatar/text pairing follows reading and scan order in an RTL message list. Vertical row order remains unchanged because it is the chronological list axis, not a left-to-right reading axis.

rtlDecisions.action: Translated messages and animated each Persian word as a joined word span while preserving whitespace tokens
rtlDecisions.why: The source uses word-level opacity and 14px rise. Preserving word units keeps the same final polish and timing without splitting Persian letters or breaking contextual joining.

rtlDecisions.action: Localized mock names to آنا، بن، کای، میا; converted timestamp digits with faDigits and used ق.ظ
rtlDecisions.why: The card requires natural Persian UI copy; the names are mock content, while time remains a numeric/time island with Persian digits.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept transform origin, zoom range, vertical row slides, spring, easing, frame offsets and seed progression unchanged
rtlDecisions.why: These are motion fidelity and physical/visual timing decisions, not language-direction semantics.

timing.notes: SWAP=32, 8-frame doodle exit, 6-frame row stagger, zoom 66-142, 13-frame row reveal stagger, 2.5-frame word stagger and +14-frame final word delay are unchanged. Persian copy length does not shift the beats.

visualVerification.observations: Frame 0 shows the mirrored doodle; frames 32-58 show the right-hand sidebar and skeleton entrance; frames 80-142 show row and word reveals with joined Persian glyphs; frame 171 shows all four rows settled.

font.reason: Vazirmatn is a loaded variable UI sans with dependable Persian glyph coverage and real weight variation for the compact names, timestamps and message copy. It matches the restrained Helvetica-like product UI mood without fake bold or fallback shaping.

rasterHandling.action: None required; the card contains only procedural SVG doodle geometry and CSS UI shapes.
